correctness.rationale: The exact path unsigned incidence matrix B has full column rank, G=B^T B has 2 on diagonal and +1 on adjacent off-diagonals. The signed-Dirichlet inverse is A_ij=(-1)^(i+j)min(i,j)(m+1-max(i,j))/(m+1); affine tangent barycentric-gradient Gram is H=A-bb^T/t with b=A1, t=1^TA1. Its positive diagonal and exact equal/opposite parity signs give all m-choose-2 ridge angles including sole endpoint zero for odd m. Scaling m^-1 A to the Green kernel, parity sublattice Riemann sums, and integrating 2∫[0,1] a y/[1-(1-a)y] dy yields the given nonuniform logarithmic cosine CDF. Independent exact affine-difference metric inversion for m=3..12 checked signs and exceptional zero; finite checks only corroborate the all-m proof.
